paper.abstract_en: We study holographic entanglement entropy in the flat limit of AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$, and clarify the relation between Ryu-Takayanagi surfaces and the swing surfaces proposed for flat-space holography. We show that the ordinary RT formula does not admit a well-defined flat-space limit and connect this to subtleties of the state-operator map in the flat limit. We then construct an AdS$_3$ uplift of the swing prescription and develop its corresponding information-theoretic interpretation through two complementary approaches. First, we show that the swing surface length computes the mutual information between suitably chosen nearly null boundary intervals in a special class of pure CFT states. The gravity interpretation of this result involves scattering processes which take place deep inside of the AdS$_3$ bulk. Second, we reduce the problem of finding an information-theoretic interpretation for swing surfaces to the more general problem of finding an information-theoretic interpretation of black hole inner horizons in holography.

decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$平极限下的全息纠缠熵，并澄清了Ryu-Takayanagi曲面与为平空间全息提出的swing曲面之间的关系。我们表明，通常的RT公式不具备定义良好的平空间极限，并将此与平极限中态-算符映射的微妙之处联系起来。随后我们构造了swing方案的AdS$_3$提升，并通过两种互补途径发展其相应的信息论解释。首先，我们表明swing曲面长度计算了一类特殊纯CFT态中适当选取的近乎零类边界区间之间的互信息。该结果的引力解释涉及发生在AdS$_3$体内部深处的散射过程。其次，我们将为swing曲面寻找信息论解释的问题，归结为在全息中为黑洞内视界寻找信息论解释这一更为一般的问题。
